_note: Thresholds and steps for the capacity run (docs/CAPACITY.md). Report only: nothing here gates a merge or a release. Every number a verdict uses is stated here, not in code.

stub._note: Fixed delays, so the stub's own share of a turn is a known constant rather than noise. Each lesson turn makes one non-stream call (the moderation check) before the streamed reply.

thresholds._note: A step is supported only when it ran and met every threshold, and so did every smaller step. first_token_excess is the step's p95 first-token time minus the one-session step's median, so the stub's own fixed delay is not counted against Bede.
thresholds._cpu_note: CPU thresholds apply to the 75th percentile of one-second samples (sustained use), not to a single spike such as a page load.
thresholds.binding_utilisation_note: The binding limit at the supported step is the one with the highest utilisation: pool (most connections checked out / pool size plus overflow), rate limit (busiest client's requests per minute in a bucket / that bucket's limit), CPU (API process CPU / one core), memory (RSS / mem_limit), model stub (stub p95 call time / its configured delay).

reference._note: DECISIONS.md entry 10: the Family Membership is up to six children (core/licensing.py seats). Shown on the curve as a reference line, never used as a gate.
